verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a training opt-out, a zero-data-retention setting, or any policy stating that customer documents are excluded from model training. The only related evidence is self-hosted or single-container deployment that keeps document data in the customer's environment for residency and sovereignty. That is an adjacent deployment control, not a documented capability to prevent data from being used for training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
